baseRoomPromptTemplate: Use case: precise production game-asset edit. Image 1 is the exact target 16:9 full-room backplate for a gothic early-2000s Diablo-like 2D 3/4 top-down ARPG. Return one COMPLETE FULL ROOM IMAGE, never an isolated gate, cutout, sprite, overlay, crop, contact sheet, or UI mockup. Preserve Image 1's exact camera, 16:9 framing, room footprint, floor, walls, stairs, doorway positions, lighting, color grade, and empty arena. Do not redesign, reframe, crop, zoom, mirror, move, or add anything outside the four existing doorway interiors. Edit only the north/top, east/right, south/bottom, and west/left passages so each contains a fully lowered heavy aged iron portcullis installed behind its original jambs. Each gate spans the full dark doorway mouth, recessed at the threshold, with bars descending from a hidden overhead slot, pointed tips meeting the threshold, restrained contact shadow, and the room's native reflected light. No runes or floating plaques. Perspective is critical: east and west gates are narrow oblique vertical barriers following each side corridor and stairs; south is a vertical foreground portcullis, never a floor grate. All iron remains behind native jambs and never spills onto the arena floor. Images 2 and 3 are reference only for recessed installation and 3/4 perspective. Keep Image 1's identity and geometry. No characters, monsters, loot, effects, text, logos, borders, or transparency.
